scope: Independent re-read of the two ASR token records, mapped through the already-authorized affine edit, with new decode/recomputation of the same RMS-envelope windows. No new ASR model run.
full_script_limit: Both ASR records omit initial I; this shared omission does not establish absence in generated speech. This audit resolves lag-domain ambiguity and does not certify all phonemes.

affine_map.equation: original_native_s = narration_s * rate + intercept; retimed_native_s = (original_native_s - intercept) / rate

wrong_word_alias_basis: At +0.54 s, same-word positions in the first window are missed by roughly half a second. For example haven aligns nearer this, sold nearer particular, and particular nearer though. These are distinct lexical positions. The near-zero branch tracks the matching words; the slightly higher envelope score is a wrong-word envelope alias.

domain_derivation.method: Expand entire observed matched-token residual range by 0.12 s on each side for approximate DTW anchors, then round outward to 0.1 s. This yields [-0.3, 0.3], chosen from word timing rather than to reduce measured gate spread.

independent_envelope_recomputation.method: ffmpeg mono48000Hz float decode; RMS480sample windows; speech bounds=max(20thpercentile*3,max*.08); same three equal narration speech windows; mean-centered normalized correlation; 10ms lag steps. No threshold, window, or transform changes.

recommendation: A separately versioned native-offset record constrained to the lexical domain is defensible, provided explicit selection binds this audit and preserves the failed unrestricted record. Audit is not a gate mutation, restoration approval, normal-speed motion review or owner acceptance.
limitations: Single small.en ASR model and approximate DTW anchors; no independent second recognizer.

Affine rate was fitted from these lexical anchors, so residual compactness alone is not independent proof of the retime quality. Distinct word identity at the disputed lag and audio-envelope recomputation provide the specific alias evidence.
Speech-edge difference 0.08 to -0.24 indicates residual endpoint variation; broad word anchors are not sample-accurate.
No perceptual audio or mouth-sync certification in this audit.
